title: Heroes of the Multiverse
description: Heroes of the Multiverse is a Modpack with the characters from the comics/films of the Marvel and DC Universe.
body:
![Heroes of the Multiverse Header](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Heroes_Multiverse/BH_Heroes_Multiverse_header.webp)
[![Heroes of the Multiverse Bisecthosting](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Heroes_Multiverse/BH_Heroes_Multiverse_promo.webp)](https://tinyurl.com/amy67484)
![Heroes of the Multiverse Description](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Heroes_Multiverse/BH_Heroes_Multiverse_description.webp)
---
**Heroes of the Multiverse** is a sci-fi based Modpack themed after superheros from the multiverse. Spiderman, Iron man, Ant man, Wolverine and so many more of your favourite heros! Will you choose from Marvel or X-Men? Bosses or dungeons, your adevnture awaits today!

---
![Heroes of the Multiverse Features](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Heroes_Multiverse/BH_Heroes_Multiverse_features.webp)
---
- [⚔️] **SuperHeros** - X-Men or Marvel, choose from all the heros of the multiverse!
- [🥏] **Performance** - Don't let that pesky performance get in the way of your fun! Enjoy a fully optimised pack for all systems, shaders too!

---
[![Heroes of the Multiverse Discord](https://www.bisecthosting.com/images/CF/Heroes_Multiverse/BH_Heroes_Multiverse_discord.webp)](https://discord.gg/N8tUm6N4Qc)
